name: Notes of Hearts
source: In a world of fantasy and magic, you are a rising strategician unraveling the mysterious magical events occurring all over the world. You are free to choose your gender as well as your species, which ranges from Human, Canine, Feline, Avian, Dragon and Fae. You will meet many characters, most of which anthropomorphic in your adventure who you may befriend or seek a deeper connection with. There are multiple romance options not bound by species or gender.
translation: 在奇幻和魔法的世界中，你是一位冉冉升起的战略家，解开世界各地发生的神秘魔法事件。你可以自由选择你的性别和物种，包括人类、犬科动物、猫科动物、鸟类、龙和妖精。你会遇到许多角色，其中大多数都是拟人化的，你可能会在冒险中与他们成为朋友或寻求更深入的联系。有多种浪漫选择，不受物种或性别的限制。
